string.description: Identifier of the team to retrieve. Use the `id` returned by team list or create responses.
Optional free-text description of the team.
Human-readable team name displayed throughout Tsuga and used in team search.

Tag value attached to the resource for this key. Tsuga returns the value exactly as stored.

string.description: `public` makes team-owned resources discoverable according to access controls. `private` restricts discovery to team members and authorized users.

Lowercase email address for the user. Use this for display and invitation matching, not as a stable identifier.
Display name of the user.
Organization role for the user: `admin`, `public_editor`, `public_viewer`, `teams_only`, or `custom` when the user holds a custom role.
Telemetry tag key to track as a custom usage dimension. The key must be unique within the organization.
Unique identifier of the custom usage tag. Generated by Tsuga.

ID of the team that owns the dashboard folder. Required and used for folder access control.

Date and time after which the key stops working. When the caller is an operation API key, set a future expiration, no later than the caller's own when the caller expires.
Kebab-case name for the operation API key.
ID of the team that owns the operation API key. When the caller is an operation API key, the team must be within the caller's scope.

map.description: Resource types the key can act on, each mapped to `read` or `write`. `write` also grants read access. A resource type absent from the map is not accessible to the key at all. Keys are API resource types such as `dashboard`, `dashboard-folder` or `logs`.

string.description: Team-access boundary for the operation API key. Set when the key is created or updated. `all` can reach all teams, `owning-team-and-public` can reach the owning team and public teams, and `owning-team-only` can reach only the owning team.
Tag key to attach to the resource.

string.description: Unique identifier of the operation API key. Generated by Tsuga when the key is created. Use this as the stable key identifier when correlating API calls with audit logs or key-management records.
The full API key value. Only available at creation time; not retrievable afterwards.

Last characters of the operation API key secret. Set by Tsuga from the generated secret and returned because the full secret is only shown once at creation. Use this to distinguish saved keys without exposing the secret.
Telemetry signal retained by this policy: logs, metrics, traces or rum.

int64.description: Number of days Tsuga should retain matching telemetry. Valid values are 1 through 3650.

string.description: Environment tag value this policy applies to. Omitted policies apply across environments unless a more specific policy exists.

bool.description: Set to true for the policy to participate in retention resolution.

string.description: Team ID this policy applies to. Omitted policies apply globally unless a team-specific policy exists.
Unique identifier of the retention policy. Generated by Tsuga.

list.description: URL prefixes which RUM telemetry data can be sent from. Supports wildcard matching. At least one prefix is required for `web` applications, and the array must be empty for `ios` and `android` applications.

string.description: Kind of application the token is issued for. Only `web` telemetry is checked against `allowedUrlPrefixes`, since mobile applications do not send an `Origin` header. Fixed at creation: an update must resend the token's current value.
